default_proof.language_scope: English proof + later EN/VI transfer experiments
default_proof.role: first neural proof; not final size claim

size_rival.role: mandatory English dynamic-routing rival; external reported metrics must be reproduced

compression_default.tokenizer: EN+VI unigram/BPE tournament, default candidate 24k with byte fallback
compression_default.initialization: reuse A13 transformer body where compatible; distill new embedding/tokenizer and relation geometry
compression_default.activation_rule: A13 must first pass core quality gates

capacity_trigger.run_A22_if: A13 remains >2 absolute points behind a preregistered semantic/dynamic floor on at least 2 independent families after relation distillation and top-layer unfreezing, or misses OOD/calibration floor due to semantic insufficiency
capacity_trigger.do_not_run_A22_if: gap is isolated to one dataset, candidate-mining failure, calibration-only failure, or data leakage/shortcut issue
